mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reservation (u_id, treatment_id, admin_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_status, member_memo, admin_memo, pms_sync_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{uId}, #{treatmentId}, #{adminId}, #{reservationDate}, #{reservationTime}, COALESCE(#{reservationStatus}, 'PENDING'), #{memberMemo}, #{adminMemo}, COALESCE(#{pmsSyncStatus}, 'PENDING'), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT reservation_id, u_id, treatment_id, admin_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_status, member_memo, admin_memo, pms_sync_status, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation ORDER BY reservation_id

SELECT reservation_id, u_id, treatment_id, admin_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_status, member_memo, admin_memo, pms_sync_status, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation WHERE u_id = #{uId} ORDER BY reservation_id

SELECT reservation_id, u_id, treatment_id, admin_id, reservation_date, reservation_time, reservation_status, member_memo, admin_memo, pms_sync_status, created_at, updated_at FROM reservation WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} ORDER BY reservation_id

mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET treatment_id = #{treatmentId}, admin_id = #{adminId}, reservation_date = #{reservationDate}, reservation_time = #{reservationTime}, reservation_status = #{reservationStatus}, member_memo = #{memberMemo}, admin_memo = #{adminMemo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}

UPDATE reservation SET pms_sync_status = #{pmsSyncStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId}
